title: SLO Insight Bridge — unified trace/metric backfill and anomaly provenance explorer
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Our SLO alerts frequently surface with insufficient context because traces are sampled aggressively and metrics/log windows misalign with short-lived spikes. That makes burn-rate alerts and anomaly triage noisy and slow to resolve. Goal: build a lightweight "SLO Insight Bridge" service that performs retroactive trace/metric backfill and exposes an anomaly provenance explorer in the Console. The Bridge will: 1) materialize short-term inferred-span signals from metrics/logs when raw traces are missing, 2) attach provenance scores tying SLO degradation to likely services/regions/models, and 3) provide an interface for on-call to jump to corroborating traces/related logs and suggested runbook steps.
acceptance_criteria: Bridge ingests metric/window snapshots and produces inferred-span events for at least 90% of burn-rate alerts in staging.
Provenance explorer surfaces a top-3 ranked root cause with a confidence score for >= 80% of seeded incidents in the test harness.
End-to-end latency for backfill inference <= 6 minutes in staging for a 1 hour alert window.
No more than 15% additional cost to observability ingestion at P50; clear cost knobs (sampling/ttl) available.
UX: Console shows provenance timeline, links to first matching trace (if available), related logs, and a suggested runbook action with one-click acknowledge/follow-up.
Automated integration tests and an incident simulation playbook are committed to repo and linked in the ticket.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (Design, 1 week): finalize heuristics for inferring spans from percentile-shift metrics, error-rate spikes, and log-signature deltas; define provenance scoring model (signal-weighted Bayes-ish heuristic).

Phase 2 (Core infra, 2 weeks): implement Bridge microservice with incremental ingestion from metrics pipeline and a bounded inference window; store inferred events in observability events index with TTL.
Phase 3 (Explorer UI, 1 week): Console panel prototype that queries Bridge and shows timeline + top causes + direct links to traces/logs and runbooks.
Phase 4 (Validation & Load, 1 week): run synthetic incident harness and A/B test on a small set of services; collect precision/recall metrics.
Phase 5 (Rollout, 1 week): opt-in beta for infra and platform customers; monitor cost and false-positive rate and iterate.
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: We chose an inference-based approach (metric->inferred-span) instead of retaining full traces due to retention/cost constraints in hosted environments.
Provenance scoring will be heuristic-first (signal weighting) to ship quickly; plan to replace with a lightweight ML scorer if heuristics underperform.
Retention for inferred events will default to 7 days with a configurable low-latency cache for 1 hour to optimize common incident workflows.
Sampling knobs exposed to customers: inference aggressiveness (high/medium/low) and per-service opt-out to avoid privacy-sensitive data inference.
We will not attempt cross-customer correlation; Bridge runs in tenant-scoped mode only for privacy and data isolation.
We accept up to 1.5x increase in Console query latency for provenance lookups during beta windows; we will optimize query path before GA.
testing_and_validation: Synthetic incident harness (GitHub: gh/redwood-inference/observability-harness/pull/187) with 2000 seeded incidents across 30 services.
Metrics: precision/recall of root-cause suggestions, average inference latency, additional ingest cost per million metrics.
Canary plan: enable on 5 small teams for two weeks with daily quality review and rollback flag.
Runbook validation: each suggested runbook step must be mapped to an existing playbook or marked for authoring with triage owner.
Success gate: precision >= 70% and false-positive rate <= 15% on canary.
rollout_and_monitoring: Opt-in beta toggle in Console per org.
Monitor signals: inferred-event-rate, provenance-precision, cost-per-event, queries-per-minute from Explorer.
Alerting: automated rollback if inferred-event-rate exceeds baseline by 3x or system error rate > 2%.
Dashboard: provenance-health dashboard linked in attachments.
runbook_and_oncall_notes: When an SLO burn-rate alert triggers, open the provenance explorer before paging; if top-1 cause confidence > 0.8, include cause in page message.
If provenance explorer is empty, follow existing trace + log triage flow; file a ticket against ENG-532809 (backfill diagnoser).
On-call can toggle inference aggressiveness; default to 'medium' for safety.
Document false-positive examples in the incident-feedback form to improve heuristics.
